text:
You can add your own shortcuts to the
sidebar. This tutorial uses fictional

Select the plus beside Operations to open
Add menu item.

A shortcut can be an Object, which is a
Crewflow page, a filtered View, a Record,
Choose View, and pick a filtered list.

Give the shortcut a name and an icon, then
select Add.

The shortcut appears under Operations.
Opening it goes through the normal page,
so your usual access still applies.

Use the options button on a shortcut to
rename or remove it. Shortcuts are saved

on this device, for your account and
workspace.
